notes:
Asking a question alongside an edit gets an answer about both halves.

If you type something like "what does enhance do and mute it", Crisp now runs the mute and tells you the other half was a question — for two builds it ran the edit and said nothing at all about what you had asked. Internal to this release: a batch of self-checks that had quietly stopped running are working again, including the ones that guard Crisp Pro.
